requirements.general: Pass SPM / SPMV / O-Level with credit in at least 3 subjects; OR Pass Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia (SKM) (Level 3 MQF) in relevant field subject to Senate approval and MUST attend bridging courses; OR A pass in Sijil Tinggi Persekolahan Malaysia (STPM), with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.0) in any subject ; OR Any qualifications equivalent to Certificate (Level 3, MQF) in the related field with at least CGPA of 2.00; OR A pass in Sijil Tinggi Agama Malaysia (STAM) with a minimum grade of Maqbul; OR Any other qualifications that recognized by the Malaysian government Language Requirements International Students Minimum score of 5.0 for IELTS OR its equivalent.
